row.evidence: Calendly's pricing page lists "Automate and secure user identities using SCIM" only for Enterprise ("Starts at $15k /yr Starts at 50 seats"), and the SCIM help article is marked "Plans: Enterprise".
row.notes: Status unchanged from June (gated). Price change: June recorded Standard $12 and Teams $20 per user/month (annual); the pricing page (Billed yearly) now shows Standard $10 and Teams $16 per seat/month. The page's embedded price data suggests $12/$20 are now the monthly-billing prices, but that data is not visible page text, so it is not cited. Enterprise starts at $15k/yr with a 50-seat minimum. SAML SSO is a paid add-on on Teams (price unlisted) and included in Enterprise; SCIM is Enterprise-only and requires SAML first. Calendly does not support SAML JIT. SCIM deactivation is reversible; delete is permanent. Some older Enterprise plans have SAML but not SCIM. The v2 REST API (all plans, including Free) can list, invite and remove organization members; the activity log API is Enterprise-only.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: SAML SSO only with the optional SSO security add-on (price not listed).

auth.token_source: Admin → Access → Single sign-on → Optional: Connect SCIM → Generate new bearer token (Settings → Access → User provisioning in the Entra guide)
auth.token_expiry: configurable (admin chooses when the token expires)

endpoints.notes: Base URL is copied from the admin console and not published. Entra group provisioning must be turned off; groups are assigned via a user attribute instead.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivate (active=false / OneLogin Suspend) keeps the user's data so the account can be reactivated; Delete permanently removes the user and their Calendly data, and a pre-existing personal account reverts to a free solo user.

custom.how: Group attribute 'group' in urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Calendly:2.0:User (Entra) / namespace urn:calendly:scim:schemas:2.0:User (Okta), mapped to Calendly groups in Settings → Access → User provisioning.

attributes.notes: Help article says only displayName, userName, active and externalID should be sent and extra attributes cause errors; the Okta guide keeps Given name, Family name and Primary email too.

roles.how: Roles are changed in Calendly (Settings → People → Active users), not via SCIM.

limitations.text: SAML SSO must be set up before SCIM.
Provisioning fails when all seats are full; provisioned users must accept an emailed invite and sign in via SSO before taking a seat.
Only displayName, userName, active and externalID are accepted; extra attributes cause errors.
No SCIM group push; groups are mapped from a user attribute, after which groups can't be managed manually. OneLogin's catalogue app does not support the custom group attribute.
Some older Enterprise plans include SAML but not SCIM.
Email changes require the user to verify the new address before they appear.
With SCIM enabled, users can only be removed through the IdP.

capabilities.notes: Users join by invitation; DELETE organization_memberships removes a user (admin only, not the owner). Groups and teams are read-only.

endpoints.purpose: List organization memberships (all users in an org)
Remove a user from the organization
Invite a user to the organization

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook events cover invitees, no-shows, event types, routing forms, meeting recaps and contacts; no user or membership events. Webhooks need a paid plan.

rate_limits.text: 500 requests per user per minute on paid plans, 50 on Free.

limitations.text: An organization owner can't be removed via the API.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate as checked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Calendly's Entra guide uses the app you created for SAML SSO; no Microsoft Learn tutorial found (calendly-tutorial returns 404).

onelogin.notes: From Calendly's own OneLogin guide; OneLogin's connector page was not loaded.
